title: Uruguayan Empanadas with Zesty Cheese Filling
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, this recipe combines the earthy flavors of Uruguay with a zesty cheese filling.

ingredients.name: Zesty Cheese Filling (Queso con Aji)
ingredients.notes: Mix of Queso Fresco, diced onion, and chopped fresh cilantro

ingredients.name: Earthly Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Mix of dried oregano, cumin, and paprika

instructions: Roll out empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the Zesty Cheese Filling in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve warm.
